dialogue.origin: こんにちわ　相談員を務めます宜しくお願い致します　お時間までもう少しお待ちください
dialogue.content: Hello, I'll be your counselor today. It's a pleasure to meet you. Please wait just a little longer until our scheduled time.

dialogue.origin: こんにちわ。相談者役を務めさせて頂きます。よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Hello. I will be playing the role of the client. Pleased to meet you.

dialogue.origin: それでは　改めまして相談員です今日はご相談ありがとうございますまずはお名前をお伺いしてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: Alright then, let me reintroduce myself. I'm your counselor. Thank you for consulting with me today. First, may I ask for your name?

dialogue.origin: まんちんと呼んで下さい。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Please call me Manchin. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: まんちんさんですね　ありがとうございます本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Manchin, is it? Thank you. What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: 両親が嫌で。。。というか怖くて。。。
dialogue.content: I can't stand my parents... or rather, I'm scared of them...

dialogue.origin: はい　ご両親が嫌なのですね　怖い。。とは　何か深い訳がありそうですねもう少し詳しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: I see, you can't stand your parents. And you say you're scared of them... It sounds like there's a deep reason for that. Could you please tell me a little more?

dialogue.origin: はい。実家は広島なのですが、両親が嫌で東京に逃げてきました。
dialogue.content: Yes. My family home is in Hiroshima, but I ran away to Tokyo because I couldn't stand my parents.

dialogue.origin: こちらで仕事もして、生活も順調にいっていたのですが。。。
dialogue.content: I found work here, and my life was going smoothly, but...

dialogue.origin: 住所も教えていないのに、家がバレてしまって、先日待ち伏せされていました。
dialogue.content: Even though I never gave them my address, they somehow found out where I live, and the other day they were waiting for me.

dialogue.origin: 逃げてきたのですか？　それはまた大がかりな事ですね
dialogue.content: You ran away? That's quite a drastic step to take.

dialogue.origin: 怖いとおっしゃっていますが　何かご両親と喧嘩か何かが起きたのですか？
dialogue.content: You said you’re scared—did something happen, like a fight with your parents?

dialogue.origin: はい、高校卒業と共に、東京のスタイリストさんに弟子入りしました。両親には何も伝えなかったでふ。
dialogue.content: Yes, as soon as I graduated from high school, I became an apprentice to a stylist in Tokyo. I didn't tell my parents anything.

dialogue.origin: 行き違ってすみません。
dialogue.content: Sorry, our messages crossed.

dialogue.origin: 小さい頃から、父親暴力を振るわれていました。
dialogue.content: Since I was little, my father was violent toward me.

dialogue.origin: いえ　大丈夫です　お父様から
dialogue.content: No, that’s all right. From your father—

dialogue.origin: ギャンブル依存症で、うまくいかないとお酒を飲んで暴れる人でした。
dialogue.content: He was a gambling addict, and when things didn't go his way, he would drink and become violent.

dialogue.origin: うわ　それは大変ですね
dialogue.content: Wow, that sounds incredibly difficult.

dialogue.origin: すみません、父親から暴力を振るわれていた、です
dialogue.content: Sorry, I meant to say, 'my father was violent toward me.'

dialogue.origin: はい。。。
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: いつ頃からその様なことが起きていたのですか？
dialogue.content: Since about when did that start happening?

dialogue.origin: もう、記憶がある頃から、ずっと。。。少なくとも小学生の頃には手を上げられていました。私の学費があるから、ギャンブルするお金が足りないって。。。
dialogue.content: For as long as I can remember... At least since I was in elementary school, he was hitting me. He would say he didn't have enough money to gamble because of my school fees...

dialogue.origin: 母親も、あんたは金が掛かってしょうがない、産むんじゃなかったって。。。
dialogue.content: My mother also used to say, 'You're so expensive, I wish I'd never had you'...

dialogue.origin: 私が殴られてても助けてくれませんでした。
dialogue.content: She never helped me, even when I was being hit.

dialogue.origin: そんなに前から起きていたのですねびっくりです　高校卒業までよく我慢されましたね　悲しくなりますね
dialogue.content: It's been happening for that long... I'm shocked. You endured it all the way through high school. That's so sad to hear.

dialogue.origin: お母様までそんなことを
dialogue.content: And your mother said such things too...

dialogue.origin: はい。。。
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: お金が無いから、逃げるに逃げれなくて。。。
dialogue.content: I didn't have any money, so I couldn't run away even if I wanted to...

dialogue.origin: これまでの人生を振り替えると辛すぎますね
dialogue.content: Looking back on your life so far, it must be incredibly painful.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。。でも、やっとあの人達と切り離した人生が送れて幸せだったのに。。。
dialogue.content: It is... But I was finally happy, living a life separate from them...

dialogue.origin: まだ未成年ですもの　お金がないのは当然です
dialogue.content: You were still a minor then; of course you didn’t have money.

dialogue.origin: はい。高校時代にバイト掛け持ちして、こっそりお金を貯めてありました。
dialogue.content: Yes. I worked multiple part-time jobs in high school and secretly saved up money.

dialogue.origin: そんな思いをもって東京にやっと逃げられたのですね　よく頑張りましたよね少しはバイトをして資金をためていたのですね
dialogue.content: So with those feelings, you were finally able to escape to Tokyo. You did so well. You must have worked part-time to save up the funds.

dialogue.origin: そのようなご両親とは縁も気ってしまいたいですよね
dialogue.content: You must want to cut all ties with parents like that.

dialogue.origin: 地獄から抜け出すためには、友達と遊ぶとか言っていられないので、バイト三昧でしたね。でも、バイトは楽しかったです。
dialogue.content: To escape that hell, I couldn't afford to hang out with friends, so I just worked all the time. But my jobs were fun.

dialogue.origin: はい、せっかく切れたのに。。。
dialogue.content: Yes, and I had finally cut them off...

dialogue.origin: そうですか　苦しい中でもバイト先が楽しくて少しの救いがあったのですね　それは良かったです
dialogue.content: I see. Even amid the hardship, your part-time jobs were enjoyable and gave you some relief. I’m glad to hear that.

dialogue.origin: はい。家の中が地獄だったので、外の世界が楽しくて！！
dialogue.content: Yes. My home was hell, so the outside world was so much fun!

dialogue.origin: 家の中では　ご兄弟とかいらっしゃらないの？
dialogue.content: At home, did you have any siblings?

dialogue.origin: いいえ、ひとりっ子です。
dialogue.content: No, I’m an only child.

dialogue.origin: 身内には相談出来る人が居なくて。。。
dialogue.content: I had no relatives I could talk to...

dialogue.origin: そうですね　それは寂しい思いをしていたのですね
dialogue.content: I see. You must have felt so lonely.

dialogue.origin: 長い時間を悩んでいたのですねお友だちにも言えない感じだったのですか？
dialogue.content: You've been struggling with this for a long time. Did you feel you couldn't tell your friends either?

dialogue.origin: はい。でも、両親がアレだから、他の人は皆んないい人に思えます！
dialogue.content: Yes. But because my parents are... like that, everyone else seems like a good person to me!

dialogue.origin: そうですね、言っても仕方ないかなと思って。暗い奴だと思われたくなかったですし。
dialogue.content: That's right. I felt there was no point in telling them. I didn't want them to think I was a gloomy person.

dialogue.origin: そうですね　家の中で辛いと外の世界で自由に出来ますね
dialogue.content: I understand. When things are hard at home, the outside world can feel freeing.

dialogue.origin: ではお友だちも多いのでは？
dialogue.content: So you probably have a lot of friends, then?

dialogue.origin: なので、高校出てからが自分の人生の始まりだと思って、色んな事を楽しく頑張れました！！
dialogue.content: That's why I felt my real life began after high school, and I was able to work hard and enjoy all sorts of things!

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね　それでやっと東京に出られて　就職も決まっていたのに
dialogue.content: I see. So you finally made it to Tokyo and had found a job, but then this happened.

dialogue.origin: 東京に来てからの友達は沢山います！仕事で知り合った人とかも、いい仲間です！！
dialogue.content: I have a lot of friends I've made since coming to Tokyo! The people I've met through work are great friends, too!

dialogue.origin: それは良かったですひとまず安心ですね
dialogue.content: That's wonderful to hear. That's a relief, at least.

dialogue.origin: はい、スタイリストアシスタントから一人前になるには、なかなか時間が掛かりましたが、なんとか独り立ちできました！
dialogue.content: Yes, it took a while to go from a stylist's assistant to a full-fledged stylist, but I managed to stand on my own!

dialogue.origin: もう一人立ちできているのですか？すごく頑張ったのですね
dialogue.content: You're already independent? You must have worked so hard.

dialogue.origin: はい、ただ、両親のことは特殊なのであまり話したりは出来ていません。。。
dialogue.content: Yes, but my situation with my parents is unusual, so I haven't really been able to talk about it much...

dialogue.origin: いいえ、5年かかりました。。。
dialogue.content: Well, it took five years...

dialogue.origin: ただ、それで映画のエンドロールに私の名前が出たのを地元の友達が観たみたいで。。。
dialogue.content: But then, a friend from my hometown apparently saw my name in the end credits of a movie...

dialogue.origin: 特殊と言われるのは　その暴力をふるう事でうすね　エンドロールに
dialogue.content: When you say 'unusual,' you mean because of the violence, right? And your name was in the end credits...

dialogue.origin: そうです。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 友達が見つけて
dialogue.content: A friend saw it...

dialogue.origin: 爆弾抱えた人みたいに思われたくなくて。
dialogue.content: I don't want to be seen as someone carrying around a bomb, so to speak.

dialogue.origin: そうですね　　爆弾とは　まんちんさんの事？
dialogue.content: I see. By 'bomb,' do you mean yourself, Manchin?

dialogue.origin: まわりまわって、両親に私がスタイリストで成功していることがバレてしまいました。
dialogue.content: Through the grapevine, my parents found out that I was succeeding as a stylist.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。。　成功のうらはらな結果がでてしまったということですね
dialogue.content: I see... So your success had an unfortunate flip side.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。親から暴力振るわれてた人って、精神的にヤバそうというか。。。
dialogue.content: Yes. People who've been abused by their parents seem mentally unstable or something...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 気を遣われるのも嫌で。私の前だと両親の話が出来ないとか思われるのも面倒じゃないですか。
dialogue.content: I hate it when people walk on eggshells around me. And it would be a pain if they felt they couldn't talk about their parents in front of me.

dialogue.origin: 話が前後してしまってすみません。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for jumping around.

dialogue.origin: まんちんさんが精神的にやばそうと思われると　そう感じていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.content: So you feel that people might see you as mentally unstable, then.

dialogue.origin: いえ　いいですので　思った事をおっしゃってくださいね
dialogue.content: No, it’s fine. Please feel free to say whatever comes to mind.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございます。はい、皆んなそう思うんじゃないですか？腫物を触るみたいな感じになるんじゃないかなって、思って。。。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Yes, wouldn’t most people think that? I imagine they’d walk on eggshells around me...

dialogue.origin: 今までにその様に接して来た方がおられたとか？
dialogue.content: Has anyone actually treated you that way before?

dialogue.origin: いいえ、話した事ないので。。。でも、映画観とか本とかだと、そういう事多く無いですか？
dialogue.content: No, because I've never told anyone... But in movies and books, that happens a lot, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: すみません、映画とか本とかです。
dialogue.content: Sorry, I meant movies and books.

dialogue.origin: そうですねなんとなくお話を聞かせていただきましてまんちんさんのお悩みを考えて見ましたそれでは　今までのお話をまとめさせていただいてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. After listening to your story, I've been thinking about what you're going through. Would it be alright if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.origin: はい。。。
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: まんちんさんは　幼いころからご両親が怖くて　一人で日々辛い思いをもち高校までなんとか過ごしてきました
dialogue.content: Manchin, since you were a child, you've been afraid of your parents, and you spent your days suffering alone, somehow making it through high school.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 痛いのも、お前なんていなければよかったのに、って言われるのも、凄く嫌でした。
dialogue.content: I hated the pain, and I hated being told 'I wish you'd never been born.'

dialogue.origin: お父様からは暴力　お母様から暴言　産むんじゃなかったとまで言われて悲しい思いだったのですね
dialogue.content: Violence from your father, verbal abuse from your mother... even being told she wished you hadn't been born. That must have been so sad.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。とても悲しかったし、このままだと殺されると思いました。
dialogue.content: Yes. It was very sad, and I thought I would be killed if things continued that way.

dialogue.origin: 生きた心地はしないですね普通なら守られるべき　家族にそんな思いをもち続けてきたなんて
dialogue.content: It must have felt like you weren't really living. To have felt that way for so long with your family, who should have been the ones protecting you.

dialogue.origin: 普通は守ってもらえるものなんですよね、羨ましいですね。
dialogue.content: Normally you’re supposed to be protected, right? I envy that.

dialogue.origin: 高校を卒業して自力で仕事も成功してやっと安定をしてきた矢先に
dialogue.content: After graduating high school, you found success in your career on your own and were finally settling down, and just then...

dialogue.origin: ご自身の名前が公に出てしまい　両親に居場所を知られてしまったという現状ですね
dialogue.content: ...your name became public, and your parents found out where you are. That's the current situation.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なんで家までバレてしまったのか。。。
dialogue.content: How did they even find out where I live...

dialogue.origin: まんちんさんは本当の家族というものも知らずに今まで生きてこられて　とても可愛そうな境遇だったと思います
dialogue.content: I think you’ve had to live without knowing what a loving family is. It’s a very unfortunate circumstance.

dialogue.origin: 可愛いそう。。。
dialogue.content: Unfortunate...

dialogue.origin: ですかね。。。
dialogue.content: Is that what it is...

dialogue.origin: 逃げる事に必死で普通の人生ではなかったように思います
dialogue.content: It seems like you were so focused on escaping that you didn't have a normal life.

dialogue.origin: もっと子供は親に甘えて美味しいものを食べて　欲しいものを買ってもらって
dialogue.content: Children should be able to rely on their parents, eat good food, and have them buy things they want.

dialogue.origin: 確かに家族に対する愛情は全く無いし、あの人達が死んでも悲しくもなんとも無いけれど。。。
dialogue.content: It's true that I have absolutely no love for my family, and I wouldn't feel sad at all if they died, but...

dialogue.origin: 逃げる事に必死なだけの人生だったとは思っていません。
dialogue.content: I don't think my life was just about desperately trying to escape.

dialogue.origin: そんな事は考えた事も望んだ事もありませんでした。
dialogue.content: I never thought about or wished for those kinds of things.

dialogue.origin: ある意味凄く強く生きてこれたのかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: In a sense, you may have lived with great strength.

dialogue.origin: でも、決定的に何かが足りないと。。。
dialogue.content: But I feel like something essential is missing...

dialogue.origin: 決定的ななにか？
dialogue.content: Something essential?

dialogue.origin: あなたが言いたいのかな、と思って。。。
dialogue.content: I thought that's what you were trying to say...

dialogue.origin: ある意味強いけど、親の愛を知らずに、逃げる事に必死で可愛そうだと仰るので。。。
dialogue.content: Because you said that I'm strong in a way, but pitiable for not knowing a parent's love and for being so desperate to escape.

dialogue.origin: いえ、足りないという意味ではないのですが、辛い人生を送ってきて　親の愛情を知らないというのは
dialogue.content: No, I didn't mean that something is lacking, but to have lived such a difficult life and not known a parent's love...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私の周りにもいますし、私も同じようなものでした
dialogue.content: I have people around me like that, and I was in a similar situation myself.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 内情は同じではないですが、私も逃げていました
dialogue.content: Though the details are different, I was running away too.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。
dialogue.content: You were?

dialogue.origin: 逃げる事は悪い事でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is running away a bad thing?

dialogue.origin: 私の友人もお父さんが酒乱で暴力もあげていたし
dialogue.content: A friend of mine also had a father who was a violent drunk.

dialogue.origin: いえ　逃げ切る事ができたらそれは凄いことだと思いますよ
dialogue.content: No, I think being able to escape completely is an amazing thing.

dialogue.origin: 私は無理でした
dialogue.content: I couldn't do it.

dialogue.origin: 酒乱の大人の男が暴れた時の恐怖は大変なものがあります。
dialogue.content: The terror when a grown man goes on a drunken rampage is overwhelming.

dialogue.origin: 逃げ切れなかったって事ですか？
dialogue.content: You mean you couldn't escape completely?

dialogue.origin: それとも和解出来たんですか？
dialogue.content: Or were you able to reconcile?

dialogue.origin: そうですか　私は酒乱の現場は知らないですが友達は苦しんでいました　今もです
dialogue.content: I see. I haven't witnessed that kind of drunken rage myself, but my friend was suffering. She still is.

dialogue.origin: 私は逃げ切れなかったですが　父は他界しました
dialogue.content: I wasn't able to get away, but my father has passed away.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 悲しいというお気持ちにはなりましたか？お辛いですか？
dialogue.content: Did you feel sad? Was it painful for you?

dialogue.origin: でも　最期は私一人が父を見とりました
dialogue.content: But in the end, I was the only one who was with my father at his passing.

dialogue.origin: 見捨てなかったのはあなただけだったと。。。
dialogue.content: So you were the only one who didn’t abandon him...

dialogue.origin: お父さんは、何か仰っていらっしゃいましたか？
dialogue.content: Did your father say anything?

dialogue.origin: もう父親もやっと会話ができる時に　私の心を訴えました
dialogue.content: When he could still manage to speak, I told him what was in my heart.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 父は逃げる私の腕を捕まえていました
dialogue.content: My father grabbed my arm as I was trying to run away.

dialogue.origin: どんなお気持ちだったんでしょう。
dialogue.content: I wonder what he was feeling.

dialogue.origin: あなたも、お父様も。
dialogue.content: Both you and your father.

dialogue.origin: それはびっくりでした
dialogue.content: It took me by surprise.

dialogue.origin: お互いになにかはき違えていた感じでしたちちはもう何も話せませんでしたが
dialogue.content: It felt like we had both misunderstood something. My father couldn't speak anymore, though.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お気持ちは感じることが出来た。。。
dialogue.content: So you were able to feel his feelings...

dialogue.origin: という事でしょうか。
dialogue.content: Is that what you mean?

dialogue.origin: なんだか私がカウンセリングを受けた感じですが　なんとなく最期に何か訴えていたように思いました
dialogue.content: It almost feels like I'm the one receiving counseling now, but somehow I felt he was trying to convey something at the end.

dialogue.origin: 私も父親には何も話をしなかったたので
dialogue.content: Because I never talked to my father about anything either.

dialogue.origin: いいえ、私も父の想いを考えた事なんてなかったので。。。
dialogue.content: No... I've never thought about what my father might have been feeling either...

dialogue.origin: 子供の時から嫌っていると思ったのでしょうね
dialogue.content: He probably thought I hated him since I was a child.

dialogue.origin: お互いが気を遣いすぎて、すれ違ってしまっていたと。。。
dialogue.content: You were both trying too hard to be considerate and ended up missing each other...

dialogue.origin: そうですね　相性が悪いというか似た者同士なのか
dialogue.content: That's right. Maybe we were incompatible, or maybe we were too alike.

dialogue.origin: 磁石みたいですね。
dialogue.content: Like magnets.

dialogue.origin: 同じ局は弾きあってしまうから。。。
dialogue.content: Same poles repel each other...

dialogue.origin: もっと一杯お話したいけど時間がきてしまいました
dialogue.content: I'd love to talk more, but our time is up.

dialogue.origin: はい、もっとお父様とのお話聞きたかったです。
dialogue.content: Yes, I wanted to hear more about you and your father.

dialogue.origin: そうです　磁石はいい例えですねほんとその通りです私の父親とまた自分もよくにている時があるんです
dialogue.content: Yes, magnets are a good analogy. That's exactly right. There are times when I find I'm very similar to my father.

dialogue.origin: 私もまんちんさんの人生を聞きたいです
dialogue.content: I’d also like to hear more about your life, Manchin.

dialogue.origin: そう思える様になったのは、お父様と何かつながったと感じられた時からでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Did you start to feel that way after you felt some kind of connection with your father?

dialogue.origin: お父様に自分が似ているって、凄く暖かい言葉に感じます。
dialogue.content: To say you're similar to your father... that sounds like such a warm thing to say.

dialogue.origin: ほぼそうですね　自分でも驚きました
dialogue.content: Pretty much. I was surprised myself.

dialogue.origin: そんなに、変化がおありだったのですね。
dialogue.content: So you experienced that much of a change.

dialogue.origin: 似ているって凄く嫌な言葉だったのにねちょっとの事で変わるんですよ
dialogue.content: The words 'you're so similar' used to be something I hated. But things can change with just a small thing.

dialogue.origin: 私も両親に似てるって言われるの凄く嫌です！！
dialogue.content: I also hate it when people say I'm like my parents!

dialogue.origin: でも、暖かい気持ちになれる日がくるのかな。。。
dialogue.content: But I wonder if a day will come when I can feel warmly about it...

dialogue.origin: そうでしょう吐き出してしまえば　何か新しい風が入って来ますよ
dialogue.content: I'm sure it will. If you can let it all out, a fresh breeze will come in.

dialogue.origin: 吐き出しきりたいです。
dialogue.content: I want to let it all out completely.

dialogue.origin: これから　じっくりと一緒に考えて行きましょう
dialogue.content: Let’s take our time and work through this together.

dialogue.origin: はい、私には乗り越えられていない事も、あなたは素敵な出来事に変換できている。。。
dialogue.content: Yes. There are things I haven’t been able to overcome, but you’ve been able to transform your experiences into something meaningful...

dialogue.origin: 私のこれからを見守っていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Will you watch over me from now on?

dialogue.origin: 私は人生の半分を費やしましたもちろんです　私にできる事があればと思っていますでは　そろそろお時間もきましたのでまた次の時にでも
dialogue.content: It took me half my life. Of course. I'd like to help in any way I can. Well, our time is about up, so let's continue next time.

dialogue.origin: それは、簡単に解決できるものではないですね。覚悟しておきます。また、相談に乗ってください！
dialogue.content: This isn’t something that can be resolved easily, is it. I’ll be prepared. Please talk with me again!

dialogue.origin: かしこまりましたまんちんさんはきっと解決できますよぜひ　また相談に乗らせてください
dialogue.content: Of course. I'm sure you can resolve this, Manchin. I would be happy to speak with you again.

dialogue.origin: では　終了いたしまーす
dialogue.content: Alright, we'll end the session here.

dialogue.origin: 心強いです。有難うございました！
dialogue.content: That’s very reassuring. Thank you so much!

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした！！
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

topic.sub: 親からの暴力と心理的虐待について
